title: docs(spec): guard the nullable amount in the docs examples and the validation condition example
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X72ZKaHCwtzbWjtWFMnY9ec)_
Fixes #31334

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：七个文档页和 `ValidationRule.condition` 的 spec 示例里，对可空 `amount` 的比较补上 `record.amount != null && …` 守卫；`common-patterns` 的报销单把 `amount` 改为 `required: true`；用 `gen:docs` 重新生成 `references/data/validation.mdx`（只变 4 行）。
- 为什么改：发布期空值守卫规则会拒绝对可空字段做未守卫的大小比较或算术；照抄这些示例，要么发布被拒，要么 `requiredWhen` 静默失效（什么都不强制）。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档与 spec 描述文字，不改 schema 形状、不移动任何接受集；`@objectstack/spec` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`content/docs/getting-started/common-patterns.mdx`（唯一选了 `required: true` 而非守卫的一处）；`packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts` L180；`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` L394 起的说明文字。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs`，预期 exit 0（生成页与源一致）；下方表格是每处表达式经真实规则 `validateStackExpressions` 的前后读数。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The publish-time null-guard rule (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`, wired by `validateStackExpressions`, which `os build`, `os validate`, `os lint` and the runtime publish gate all run) refuses an ordering or arithmetic operator on a declared-nullable field unless a `!= null` / `== null` / `isBlank()` test guards it. Every site in the card compared `record.amount` unguarded in a gated position. Each is fixed with the shape the formula skill teaches (`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` L112-L122, L404).

| Site | Surface | Fix | Why this fix |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/getting-started/common-patterns.mdx` L312, flow edges `e2`/`e3` | `record_change` flow on `expense_report` | `amount` declared `required: true` | The example declares its object, and the flow branches on `amount` (`< 100` auto-approves, `>= 100` asks). Guarding the start condition instead would let a submitted report with no amount launch no flow at all, so it would skip approval silently. An expense report always has an amount, so `required: true` is the honest fix. The edges stay as written. |
| `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` L145, start `condition` | `record_change` flow start on `opportunity` | guard: `record.amount != null && record.amount >= 50000 && …` | The object is not declared. Per the ruling, a flow is guarded at its start condition, which covers every edge and branch (`validate-expressions.ts` L2967-L2976). |
| `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` L74 | hook `condition` | guard | The object is not declared. |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` L119 | field `requiredWhen` | guard | The `Invoice` example declares fields, but not `amount` (nor `subtotal`, `tax_rate`, `invoice_no`, `customer`); it is a fragment for `amount`, so it is guarded rather than given a `required` declaration it does not have. |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` L356 | field `requiredWhen` | guard | The object is not declared. |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` L394 | validation rule `condition` | guard, plus one sentence under it saying why an optional field needs the `!= null` test | The object is not declared. |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/validation.mdx` L329 | validation rule `condition` (a `validations:` fragment) | guard | The object is not declared. |
| `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` L2473 | flow start-node `condition` (syntax table) | guard | The object is not declared. |
| `packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts` L180 `.describe()` | validation `condition` | guard: ``P`record.amount != null && record.amount < 0` `` | The object is not declared. `content/docs/references/data/validation.mdx` L170/L291/L505/L571 regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:schema && gen:docs`, never hand-edited. |
| `packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts` L257 and L532 (doc comments) | `cross_field` and `conditional` rule examples | guard | Bounded in-place fix, see below. |

**Bounded in-place fix (same file, outside the card's table).** The two doc-comment examples in `validation.zod.ts` (the `cross_field` `discount_limit` at L257, and the `conditional` `enterprise_high_value` `then` at L532) have the same defect, and the rule refuses both (table below). All four conditions hold: the same defect class, the same mechanical guard shape, no other claim on the file (PR #31322 touches `hook.zod.ts`, not this file), and the same gate families. The doc comments ship in `@objectstack/spec`'s `.d.ts`, where an author or agent reads them. They do not reach the generated reference page.

Not changed (out of scope by ruling): `validation.mdx` L51 (`amount` is `required: true` at L31), the `ui/` SchemaForm test constant, release notes and CHANGELOGs.

## Tests

Each changed expression was run, in its declared context, through the real gating rule: `validateStackExpressions` from the built `@objectstack/lint` `dist/` (built on this branch's base `dc7f5c4b4`). The fixture object declares `amount` as `{ type: 'currency' }`, which is nullable (no `required`, no default), as on the CRM example's `opportunity`. Counts are error-severity null-guard findings; every row had 0 other errors.

| Site | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| common-patterns flow `e2`/`e3` | REFUSED (2: edge `e2`, edge `e3`) | accepted (`amount` `required: true`) |
| approvals.mdx start condition | REFUSED (1: start condition) | accepted |
| hook-bodies.mdx hook condition | REFUSED (1) | accepted |
| formulas.mdx L119 / L356 `requiredWhen` | REFUSED (1) | accepted |
| formulas.mdx L394 / validation.mdx L329 script rule | REFUSED (1) | accepted |
| flows.mdx L2473 start condition | REFUSED (1) | accepted |
| validation.zod.ts L180 condition | REFUSED (1) | accepted |
| validation.zod.ts L257 `cross_field` | REFUSED (2: `discount`, `amount`) | accepted |
| validation.zod.ts L532 `conditional` `then` | REFUSED (1) | accepted |

No test file changes: this is docs and description text. No test pins the old describe string (`git grep` over `packages/**`).

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts` L1070-L1071, the `FlowSchema` `@example`, has the same `record.amount < 500` / `>= 500` edges. As written its start node carries no `config.objectName`, so the rule has no object to resolve and does not refuse it (probe: 0 findings as written, 2 once the start is bound to an `order` with a nullable `amount`). Outside this card's surface and not refused at a public door today, so it is noted, not filed.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md` L164 (`discount_limit`) is already guarded.

## Verification

On head `c4bbb0ad` (merge base `dc7f5c4b4`), after building the `@objectstack/lint` closure, then `@objectstack/spec` and the `@objectstack/client-react` closure, under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: **98 of the 99 commands from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` exit 0.** `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every workspace package's `dist/`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and CI reads it. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 99 derived, 98 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0). Changed lines: 35 + the changeset, 9 files.

Also run: `packages/spec` `src/data/validation.test.ts` + `validation-boundary-description.test.ts` (2 files, 90 / 90 passed, lock VERDICT command-exit 0); eslint on `validation.zod.ts` (exit 0); `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` (exit 0); `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` (exit 0). `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exits 1 on local state only (65 of 107 packages have no `dist/` in this worktree, since only the needed closures were built); its self-test passes, and it is not a finding about this diff.

The NOT MEASURED families `dispatch-gates` names outside the derived list (CI-only steps, type-check lanes, the dogfood and build jobs) run in CI.
